scripts.pages:dev: unset CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; wrangler pages dev public --port 8788 --binding JWT_SECRET=dev-secret-not-for-production
scripts.pages:deploy: unset CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name electrics
scripts.migrate:local: unset CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; wrangler d1 migrations apply sparky-db --local
scripts.migrate:remote: unset CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; wrangler d1 migrations apply sparky-db --remote
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && bun run scripts/check-pwa-output.ts
scripts.check:web: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.check: bun run check:content && bun run check:web && bun run check:native
scripts.ios:project: bun run ios:content && cd ios && xcodegen generate
